notes.title: The demo is available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208062/5f8087a4ee76d8e0c98b097b9289ca1921aa8dd1.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone

Today we are celebrating, because the first demo version of Solar Wave is already available! This is a small, but without a doubt, a very important step towards the release of the game.

What can you try out in the game? 
[list]
[*]A dynamic and lively simulation of a space state with a well-developed economic system
[*]15 types of fleets (including several enemy fleets)
[*]22 different ships for them
[*]a bundle of stations and planets
[*]and 3 missions to test your strategic skills
[/list]
As you can guess, this is not the final version, and many aspects of the game will change by release. The game is developing dynamically, mostly based on your feedback and suggestions. Once again, I want to express my gratitude for your feedback — every day it helps me make Solar Wave better. Thank you for this opportunity!

notes.title: Hostile space and a hell of a lot of changes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208062/e15126f4f6c3b53ffe9ba7eca8cc2b13b40b8d14.png[/img]
Hi!
The first really big update for the public version of Solar Wave is ready!
Without putting it in the back drawer, a list of changes:

[list]
[*] [b]Hostile Space[/b] - The space around the player is now populated by Terroxenos. The hostile life form has its own stations, planets, and economy. The development of territories will no longer be an easy walk.

[*] [b]Enemy attacks[/b] - the logic of attacking enemy fleets has changed, they can still invade directly into the player's territory, but in most cases they will raid from their possessions.

[*] [b]Defensive stations[/b] - The addition of opponents on the map led to the formation of a front line and the division into rear and peripheral systems. In this regard, the first defensive stations have been added to the game, which can strengthen defenses in key positions.

[*] [b]Imperial Troops [/b] are the first alternative population type introduced in the game. Troops can be trained on your planets in a special structure. They serve on defensive platforms and in most imperial fleets. Troops are not used in amphibious operations [b]yet[/b], but it can significantly reduce incoming damage.

[*] [b]Interface improvements[/b] - numerous UI improvements, now it should be a little easier to understand what is happening in the game.

[*] [b]As well as a bunch of other minor edits.[/b]
[/list]
I hope you enjoy the updates in the game, and I'm also looking forward to your feedback and comments!
